# Platform support (generated by `pnpm gate`)

Run: 2026-11-04. Each site goes through the proxy health check, then Playwright (chromium desktop + WebKit iPhone 14): render, scripted interaction (scroll + hover/click a nav element → DOM/URL change), tap → anchor, re-anchor after reload.

## D3 result

- Reachable sites: **19/19**; passing on both browsers: **14** → **74%** (threshold 70%).
- Framer passes: **3** (need ≥2). Webflow passes: **2** (need ≥2).
- Gate: **PASS — live mode is the default for all platforms**.

- Mixed results (some sites pass, some fail) for: `next`, `webflow` — these stay live by default; the per-review headless health check falls back to Screenshot mode for individual sites that fail.

## Known limits

- Only the HTML document is proxied; assets load from the original host. Sites that block cross-origin asset loading by Referer, or that require cookies/login, will not work.
- Service workers and form submission are disabled in review mode by design.
- One upstream host per review session on the Phase A single proxy host; other subdomains of the same site switch the host.
- Results reflect these sites on the run date; sites change. Re-run with `pnpm gate` (or `pnpm gate <substring>` for one site).
